mainEntity.name: What files do you need to create a 3D architectural walkthrough?

acceptedAnswer.text: We need architectural floor plans (AutoCAD or PDF), elevation drawings, material preferences, and reference images. We can also work from rough sketches.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to deliver a 3D architectural walkthrough?

acceptedAnswer.text: A residential walkthrough takes 7–14 business days. Larger commercial projects may take 3–4 weeks. Expedited delivery is available.

mainEntity.name: What types of architectural projects do you visualize?

faq.desc: Everything you need to know about our 3D architectural walkthrough services in Lucknow.

items.a: A 3D architectural walkthrough is a photorealistic, computer-generated animated video that lets you virtually explore a building or space before it is constructed. It simulates real-world materials, lighting, and spatial flow — giving architects, builders, and clients complete clarity on the final structure.

items.q: What files do you need to create a 3D architectural walkthrough?
items.a: We typically require your architectural floor plans (AutoCAD, PDF, or hand-drawn), elevation drawings, section drawings, material preferences, and any reference images. If your plans are incomplete, our team can work with rough sketches and your verbal description.

items.q: How long does it take to deliver a 3D architectural walkthrough?
items.a: A standard architectural walkthrough for a residential project takes 7–14 business days. Larger commercial or township projects may take 3–4 weeks. We also offer expedited delivery for time-critical projects at an additional charge.

items.q: What types of architectural projects do you visualize?
items.a: We create 3D walkthroughs for a wide range of projects including residential bungalows, luxury villas, apartment complexes, commercial office buildings, retail stores, hotels, schools, hospitals, and large-scale real estate township developments.

items.q: Can I request changes to the 3D model after seeing the initial draft?
items.a: Absolutely. We include structured revision rounds in every project. After reviewing the initial draft, you can request changes to materials, colors, camera angles, lighting conditions, furnishings, and external landscaping before the final render.

items.q: Do you create VR-compatible architectural walkthroughs?
items.a: Yes. We deliver VR-ready walkthroughs compatible with Oculus Rift, HTC Vive, and web-based 360° viewers. This is especially popular with real estate developers who want to showcase properties at exhibitions and showrooms.

items.q: How much does a 3D architectural walkthrough cost in Lucknow?
items.a: The cost depends on the project scale, complexity, and the number of camera angles or scenes required. Our residential walkthroughs start from ₹18,000 onwards. We provide a free, detailed quotation after reviewing your project requirements.

items.q: Can the 3D walkthrough be used for real estate marketing and social media?
items.a: Yes. We deliver the final walkthrough in high-resolution 4K MP4 video format, web-optimized versions for your website, and vertical formats for Instagram Reels — making it a powerful, multi-platform marketing asset for pre-launch real estate sales.
